name: ULTRAMARINES: ROBOUTE GUILLIMAN
description: Roboute Guilliman is the Primarch of the Ultramarines, Lord of Ultramar, and a peerless leader of men. He clutches the burning Emperor's Sword and wears the Hand of Dominion, with which he can tear apart tanks and crush his foes with ease. Yet it is the Primarch’s strategic brilliance that is his greatest weapon, dooming enemies to defeat before the battle has even begun.The Avenging SonThis multipart plastic kit builds Roboute Guilliman, Primarch of the Ultramarines – a mighty warrior and peerless strategist for your Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. This impressive centrepiece model is packed with detail – the Armour of Fate that encases his body is covered in beautiful, ornate filigree patterns, purity seals, and Ultramarines Chapter icons. The Emperor’s Sword, held in his right hand, is a huge blade that burns with righteous fury, while the Hand of Dominion, the enormous gauntlet on his left hand, is also capable of unleashing hails of armour-piercing gunfire. The sculpted base depicts Guilliman standing astride a broken Imperial eagle, flanked by 2 burning torches, and standing over the body of a Chaos Space Marine. The miniature comes with a choice of 2 heads – helmeted or bare – offering a degree of customisation to the author of the Codex Astartes. Contents:– 44 plastic components– 1 Citadel 60mm Round Base– 1 construction guideThis miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue– Warhammer Colour paints
